message: As I was looking for ways to keep my grandkids engaged during our family gatherings, I stumbled upon a wonderful resource about preparedness planning. It’s a gentle reminder that sometimes, taking a step back and rediscovering low-tech fun can be the best way to connect with each other. Planning ahead doesn’t have to be overwhelming; it can simply mean setting aside some time for family chats and games. What simple joys do you enjoy with your loved ones?
